summary: All nine phases are committed on each repo's main and every requirement and ruling traces to one: R1/D1 to P4+P7, R2 to P7 (the reviewed comment) and P9 (D53), R3/D3 to P3+P6, R4/D2/R1-A1 to P1+P4+P5+P8, R5 to P2. The acceptance criteria no phase implements (V01, V03, V04, V05's live Keycloak pin, V06's sweep across the other deploy repos, V09, V17 and the live halves of V13/V15/V18) are the test phase's by design (Rulings R1-Q2, R1-Q3, D1), and the doc leftovers the done-records route onward (DockerImages README.md:19-21, registry-cleanup/architecture.yaml's summary, the design doc's silence on cleanup's dry run) are the doc phase's. So no implementation phase is owed. Two comment nits were fixed in place (close-out S2 in KubeCoderDeploy 20e0f71, S6 in DockerImages 18dadc8) and struck; the rest of the close-out (B1, Q1, Q2, S1, S3, S4, S5) is operator-facing or out of scope, and none of it is owed.
